decision: Installed the bounded green-texture recovery and its joint boundary interpolation after frozen verification, native paired comparisons and functional checks. Removes a documented local legacy colour/detail advantage on a D800 texture. No general superiority or calibrated photographic accuracy claim.

method.cause: Constant chromatic ratios cannot reproduce some coloured textures. Restoring only R/B while green remains clipped worsens final colour. Conversely, accurate green recovery can expose a pre-existing reflected-boundary error in the directional demosaic.
method.HL6: HL5 first. Otherwise only complete previously unsupported Bayer green-only components up to 192x192. Fit G=aR+bB+c+dx*x+dy*y from original observations in a 24-pixel context. Phase- and boundary-stencil-specific R/B interpolation, disjoint green fit groups, validation of every available green including held-out/near-clipped sites, finite conditioned systems and bounded colour amplification. Both predictions must agree at every missing green; lift at most 1.5 times its observed code. All original non-clipped sites preserved. No neutral assumption, renderer matching or test-reference fitting.
method.dir6: Only the physical frame margin of newly admitted texture cells. Interpolate missing R/B with original same-channel cubic samples; green along the frame boundary, average the two directions at corners. No reflection, modification of measured CFA channels, denoise, RGB clamp or extra raster. The support bit distinguishes this admission from unsupported clipping.
method.limits: The green relationship is validated where green survives; a change affecting only the hidden green cannot be identified from R/B alone. Fold predictions are spatially correlated, not independent camera observations. Highly amplified fits, multiple clipped channels, unsupported edges, noise and insufficient evidence are rejected. No new X-Trans recovery.

curvature_without_surviving_channels.reason: Quadratic/log-quadratic extrapolation helped curved peaks but worsened same-RAW flat-top hypotheses. Removed from production before final candidate. All 221 regional metric regressions were hidden-flat controls.

green_recovery_with_original_demosaic.cause: One frame-edge gradient peak rose 0.1162145138 to 0.1169642210. Ideal unclipped demosaic also gives 0.1169625521, identifying a boundary interpolation defect rather than green estimation error. Joint boundary correction reduces the selected peak to 0.1016044617.

rejected.unstable_D750_fit: The private unconstrained probe improves a reused D750 p1 texture but requires original-domain |a|+|b| above 6 and up to about 9.90 for boundary stencils. Production rejects the whole component rather than relaxing the amplification bound of 4.
rejected.development_harness_notes: Early private curvature reports used the default no-recovery text label while selecting frozen HL5/dir5; hashes and explicit flag identified the actual baseline. Fixed before final regression/verification. Private mosaic probe uses only its rendered truth metrics; its sensor diagnostics describe the ordinary pipeline and it has no production repack claim. The first native launch rejected a manifest missing schema before decoding; repaired and rerun. The initial texture-development point-error generator only perturbed some green phases; fixed before the frozen verification. Reused development counts are not independent observations.

integrity.limits: Spatial phases, overlapping regions, stochastic controls and shared-RAW hypotheses are correlated. Same generators and compatibility matrices also define truth. Not physical colour calibration.

native_comparison.limits: Counts refer to regional metric comparisons, not independent scenes. Overlapping regions and CFA phases correlated. Known-model matrices also generate truth. Chroma can be unbounded for signed RGB with small sum; no DeltaE. No general superiority or physical camera calibration claim. Pairwise common-chroma populations are recorded, not interchangeable across pairs. Preview PNGs checked visually as SDR diagnostics, not calibrated truth.

photographic_limits: Eight complete reused DNG/NEF/RAF inputs and 400 remosaics from 25 reused photographs are bit-identical. These are regression controls; no measured improvement to real photographic accuracy or noise is claimed.

performance.scope: Full pipelines in one process: frozen HL5/dir5 versus HL6/dir6, identical opt-level=3/thin LTO, source bytes, geometry and WB. Three warmups and thirty alternating pairs. Input reading/hash and output hashing excluded; parse, allocation, codec, HL, demosaic, matrix included. No concurrent build/test/GUI/campaign. Warm OS cache, uncontrolled OS/thermal activity, no cold-start or LibRaw timing claim.

open: Legacy retains local advantages on unsupported texture, coloured edges, multiple/full clipping and some peak comparisons; no universal dominance.
All ten previously tracked HL2 peak comparisons on seven scenes remain unchanged; not a fresh exhaustive HL2 comparison.
Independent calibrated photographic references, measured clipping/LED/spectral response and broader noisy texture tests remain missing.
The new fit can only infer a continuation of the observed green relationship; hidden colour changes remain ambiguous.
Previously measured D750 slowdown versus LibRaw remains open; this campaign times only autonomous revisions.
RSS under pressure, full sandbox and R0-R4/SF global gates remain unqualified. D40 and postponed point 6 excluded.
